Visage Of The Emperor is marked as the starting Effect because the objective deploys it.
The post says this deck won the 2001 Texas State Championship, with only a timed loss by 10 in 5 games; the finals opponent was John Sneed.
The effects header says 10 but 11 are listed; the strategy text confirms 'the effect total is really 11'. The list totals 60.

Posted 'Death Star Docking Bay 327' dested the Dark Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Cloud City East Platform (Docking Bay)', 'Executor Docking Bay', 'Executor Holotheatre' and 'Executor Meditation Chamber' dested the Dark sites.
Secret Plans is a 2001 Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
The 4/29 update says he added two Battle Deployments and a second Guri; the list is kept as posted (one Guri, no Battle Deployment).
